ATX closed heading style adds closing hashes

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<h1>Closed Heading</h1>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(heading_style: 'AtxClosed'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
